verdict.rationale: ZCode is positioned as an AI coding workbench with desktop, web and terminal agents. It uses multi-agent collaboration and 'Goal' planning, execution and verification to complete complex multi-step coding goals from user instructions. Hands-on users describe it as a working coding harness ('works pretty well', 'one of the best harnesses') running GLM models with full file permissions. One user reported frequent 'write EPIPE' API connection failures, which tempers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language feature/bug requests turned into multi-file edits, and independent hands-on reports of successful multi-file implementations or bug fixes.
